Class ExitScreen

org.adsl.client.view.Screen<GUIScreen>
org.adsl.client.view.gui.screens.GUIScreen
org.adsl.client.view.gui.screens.ExitScreen
All Implemented Interfaces:
EventVisitor<GUIScreen>
public final class ExitScreen extends GUIScreen
Marker screen that signals the GUI loop to terminate. Holds no JavaFX resources; the GUI top-level class checks for this type after every transition and shuts down.

  • Method Details

    • isExit

      public boolean isExit()
      Description copied from class: Screen
      Sentinel flag for terminal screens. The TUI loop stops as soon as the current screen reports true; the GUI runs its shutdown sequence. Defaults to false; the ExitScreen variants override it. Lets the runtime detect the terminal state through polymorphism instead of a subtype check.
